lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh package-lock.json on Renovate's default lockFileMaintenance schedule (#194), so transitive dependencies such as undici pick up fixed releases inside their parents' ranges. OSV vulnerability alerts cover only direct dependencies. The 'Auto-merge low-risk updates' rule automerges these PRs once CI passes.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

One Node version for CI and production (#168): .nvmrc (the Node that CI's setup-node and railpack both read) and @types/node move in one PR, so scripts/check-node-pins.sh stays green. config:recommended's group:nodeJs preset sets only a commit message topic, no group name, and does not match the npm package @types/node.
